screen_policy: Every slide must prove the exact copy through visible Aachu/Zuv behavior. Any doubtful slide blocks image generation until repaired and re-reviewed.

slide_reviews.copy:
This is the kind of love
I want us to grow into.

The date began with one missing key
and two suspects.

By the third wrong turn,
nobody was cute anymore.

“Don’t talk to me.”

He gave her the minute.
Not the distance.

It wasn’t really the wrong turn.

They had simply missed each other
for too many ordinary days.

The plan failed.
The date didn’t.

He still checked the lock twice.
She still rolled her eyes.

Then she went back
and checked it with him.

blind_cards.visible_setting: A dry apartment corridor seen entirely from outside one dominant fully closed warm-brown wooden apartment door. Two hinges are visible on the left edge. director_storyboard.physical_event: A couple leaves for a planned car date, hits small logistical friction, creates respectful space, notices the need beneath the irritation, improvises roadside chai, and is bookended by their shared pre-departure door-check ritual.
director_storyboard.emotional_arc: Playful coordination expands into a visible irritation gap, holds as a respectful pause, narrows through attention, and returns to close mutual play and affectionate self-recognition.
director_storyboard.relationship_change: They move from joking together to misaligned attention, then from space without abandonment back into a mutual improvised date and shared ritual.
director_storyboard.sequence_read: A rainy roadside workaround opens the sequence, a playful pre-departure mishap explains the couple's familiar rhythm, route frustration creates distance, respectful waiting turns into noticing, chai restores their private comedy, and a final dry departure callback reveals that her teasing has grown into joining his door-check ritual.

slides.critic_evidence: Two visible hinges on the left oppose a lever only 7 to 10 centimetres from the right slab edge, so the hardware reads as a real latch-side handle rather than an object floating in the middle of the door. The elevator leaves a black opening equal to 15 to 20 percent of its width, making interrupted departure more plausible than arrival after a fully closed lift. Three outbound prints run from the apartment threshold toward the lift, make one tight visible 180-degree U beside the opening, and become a spatially separate three-print return lane ending at the woman's raised heel. Direction ticks distinguish the outward and return legs, and the lanes meet only at the single U, so her reversal does not collapse into one decorative trail. Exactly two hands are visible: his continuously attached anatomical left hand on the edge lever and her right palm on uninterrupted wood of the same door. Clear air separates both bodies; neither person touches, crosses, or merges with the other.
